{{Infobox football league season | competition = [[Chinese Jia-A League]] | season = 1997 | winners = [[Dalian Shide F.C.|Dalian Wanda]] (3rd title) | relegated = {{ubl|[[Tianjin Jinmen Tiger F.C.|Tianjin Lifei]] | [[Guangdong Winnerway F.C.|Guangdong Hongyuan]]}} | continentalcup1 = [[1998–99 Asian Club Championship|Asian Club Championship]] | continentalcup1 qualifiers = [[Dalian Shide F.C.|Dalian Wanda]] | league topscorer = [[Hao Haidong]] (14 goals) | matches = 132 | total goals = 305 | average attendance = 21,220 | prevseason = [[1996 Chinese Jia-A League|1996]] | nextseason = [[1998 Chinese Jia-A League|1998]] }} The '''1997 Chinese Jia-A League season''' (known as '''Marlboro Jia-A League''' for sponsorship reasons) was the fourth season of professional association football and the 36th top-tier overall league season held in China. Starting on March 16 and ending on November 29, it was contested by 12 teams and [[Dalian Shide F.C.|Dalian Wanda]] won the championship making it their third championship title.{{fact|date=December 2013}} ==Events== On 20 July 1997, in a round 10 league fixture, [[Beijing Guoan F.C.|Beijing Guoan]] defeated [[Shanghai Shenhua F.C.|Shanghai Shenhua]] in the [[Jing–Hu rivalry]] by a score of [[Beijing Guoan 9–1 Shanghai Shenhua|9−1]]. ==Promotion and relegation== '''Teams promoted from 1996 Chinese Jia-B League''' * [[Chongqing Liangjiang Athletic F.C.|Qianwei Huandao]] * [[Qingdao Hainiu F.C.|Qingdao Hainiu]] '''Teams relegated from 1996 Chinese Jia-A League''' * [[Shenzhen F.C.|Shenzhen Feiyada]] * [[Guangzhou Matsunichi F.C.|Guangzhou Songri]] ==Personnel== {| class="wikitable sortable" style="font-size:95%" |- !Team !Manager |- | [[Bayi Football Team|August 1st]] | |- | [[Beijing Guoan F.C.|Beijing Guoan]] | {{flagicon|CHN}} [[Jin Zhiyang]] |- | [[Dalian Shide F.C.|Dalian Wanda]] | {{flagicon|CHN}} [[Chi Shangbin]] |- | [[Guangdong Winnerway F.C.|Guangdong Hongyuan]] | {{flagicon|CHN}} [[He Jinlun]] |- | [[Guangzhou F.C.|Guangzhou Apollo]] | {{flagicon|CHN}} [[Mai Chao]] |- | [[Shandong Taishan F.C.|Jinan Taishan General]] | {{flagicon|CHN}} [[Yin Tiesheng]] |- | [[Chongqing Liangjiang Athletic F.C.|Qianwei Huanduo]] | {{flagicon|GER}} [[Klaus Schlappner]] |- | [[Qingdao Hainiu F.C.|Qingdao Hainiu]] | {{flagicon|CHN}} [[Liu Guojiang]] |- | [[Shanghai Shenhua F.C.|Shanghai Shenhua]] | {{flagicon|POL}} [[Andrzej Strejlau]] |- | [[Sichuan First City F.C.|Sichuan Quanxing]] | |- | [[Tianjin Jinmen Tiger F.C.|Tianjin Lifei]] | {{flagicon|CHN}} [[Chen Jingang]] |- | [[Yanbian Funde F.C.|Yanbian Aodong]] | {{flagicon|KOR}} [[Choi Eun-taek]] |} == Foreign players == As a military-owned team, August 1st were not allowed to sign any foreign players. {| class="wikitable" !
